description: Read-only public page view that resolves a share token, showing loading and not-found or disabled states, otherwise rendering a locked read-only TmNotionEditor (with comments enabled only when the share allows them).

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: Public share token from the route.

parameters.name: AggregateProvider
parameters.description: Provider used to load the complete shared page aggregate.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on the public page shell.

parameters.name: CommentProvider
parameters.description: Optional comments provider enabled only when the public share allows comments.

parameters.name: DataProvider
parameters.description: Provider used to load the shared Notion page.

parameters.name: PublicShareProvider
parameters.description: Provider that resolves public share tokens.
